time_source_note: Top-level time lists before prediction_start_iteration are copied from the source profile for fitting overhead/communication. Later fwd_times are predicted from seq_lengths; later bwd_times and wwd_times are derived from f_b_ratio/f_b_w_ratio.
prediction_start_note: Iterations before this value are copied from the source profile for warmup/model/comm fitting. Iteration-level prediction/evaluation rows should start at this value.
warnings: total_tokens is constant in this dataset, so the forward model cannot identify an MLP token-length slope; MLP cost is folded into the bias term. The component MLP model still reports the measured constant linear_ms if available.
